## Schools requiring external rotations


```{r, message=F, warning=F}
# Get the names of columns matching the pattern
matching_cols <- names(data %>% select(matches("external rotations", ignore.case = TRUE)))

print(matching_cols)


target_col <- matching_cols[2]

# 2. Create a frequency and percentage summary table
freq_table <- table(data[[target_col]], useNA = "ifany") # Includes NA counts if any exist
pct_table <- prop.table(freq_table) * 100

# 3. Combine them into a clean, easy-to-read data frame
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Response = names(freq_table),
  Count = as.numeric(freq_table),
  Percentage = round(as.numeric(pct_table), 2)
)

# Print the final table
summary_df%>%
datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
          caption = "", 
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))
```
